answer: A farm paying its aliases from one wallet thus collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Because the thread graph is rebuilt each epoch, the nadir merge is applied at settlement and the ridge audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 20 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 23 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
